Recorded claim:
In the reported Try assessment at revision 2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555, obsolete #password selectors in two Account Hub Exchange tests reportedly left the Graph flow unfinished and caused a browser_actions.js timeout. When these errors occur together in this stack, inspect the earlier selector failure before assigning the timeout a separate cause. This is an assessment claim, not proof that every browser_actions.js timeout has that cause; separate account-order errors were also reported.

Provenance: 2ddedeef21df4f5e9ee9cca9b52fe25bb375cfa5a4c96f9dc80cd445e9d0778a. Original evidence IDs: 4733e4f07e14cd02dbe82a7c65d8097a161577cba48da028edb2bed53d006bea.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
Source references:
https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555
title: Recorded lesson: Check downstream timeouts after an Exchange selector failure
